blocks.text: Status: CANONICAL — ALL TRANSLATOR-READINESS GATES COMPLETE

Only a validated EZF-1 document may enter the presentation layer. The generator inverse-decodes the input before producing output, so corrupted identity, semantics, generated forms, notes, runtime endings, contours, timing, or gloss are rejected. SVG and MIDI are derived artifacts and never participate in UTT or EZF semantic identity.

EZSVG-1 renders one labeled row per lexical event. Each row connects the event’s harmonic family opening, address note path, and runtime ending as pitch points and records target ID and register as data attributes. The document includes an accessible title and description plus formal ID, semantic digest, performance profile, and primary contour metadata. Identical EZF input produces byte-identical SVG.

The audio-performance interchange is Standard MIDI File type 0 at 480 ticks per beat and a reference tempo of 500,000 microseconds per quarter note. Lexical family openings, address paths, runtime tails, and primary contour are emitted with deterministic timing and velocity. Transposition changes MIDI notes and SVG vertical coordinates while leaving the semantic digest and formal identity unchanged.

Synthesized waveform audio is optional and is not implemented in Era Zero 1.0. Choosing a synthesizer, instrument, timbre, articulation library, or recorded voice would add presentation policy not fixed by the language. MIDI preserves the complete deterministic performance interchange; any later synthesizer must consume that output without altering meaning.

The dedicated presentation validator passes 10 of 10 checks. It verifies 48 transposed presentation fixtures over all 16 Semantic-IR cases, valid accessible SVG, valid type-0 MIDI, byte determinism, exact track lengths, transposition behavior, corruption rejection, and 972 exhaustive atom/runtime SVG-and-MIDI presentations. Three example SVG/MIDI pairs are included. The complete project regression passes every semantic, compound, index, coverage, etymology, IR, renderer, controlled-English, general-English, family, and presentation check.

All seven planned translator-readiness gates are now complete. The release contains 324 canonical atoms, 28 approved compounds, 436 indexed English senses, canonical Semantic IR and grammar, exact EZF-1 rendering and decoding, controlled-English compilation, conservative general-English candidate translation, accessible SVG notation, and deterministic MIDI. The 11 recorded vocabulary gaps remain honest expansion work rather than hidden translation guesses.
